spec.moment: Eating gas station nachos in the car after retrieving it from the tow yard in the rain.

elements.name: the car
elements.look: a modest sedan with shiny wet windows and glowing interior dashboard lights

elements.name: gas station nachos
elements.look: an open paper tray of yellow tortilla chips drenched in bright orange cheese sauce with green jalapeño rings

elements.name: tow yard lot
elements.look: a dark wet asphalt parking patch with glossy rain puddles and a chain-link fence section at the back edge

spec.scene: A wet asphalt lot with shiny rain puddles fills the ground, bordered at the back edge by a tall chain-link fence under a dim amber halogen streetlamp glow. At the center sits a compact dark sedan, its roof and windshield glossy with rain. Inside, the cabin glows softly in warm dashboard light, where a small figure in a dark jacket sits behind the wheel holding a vibrant paper tray of yellow nachos dripping with bright orange cheese.
spec.title: Gas Station Nachos
spec.caption: A total mess of a day, but the nachos helped.
